## Activity

During July 2023, River Outreach recorded 42 captures. The activity provides a summary of the site’s operational output for the month and supports routine monitoring of capture volumes and grading performance. The results should continue to be reviewed through the usual reporting process so that any emerging operational issues can be identified and addressed promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 42 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.1 per cent. This result should be monitored alongside any equipment or camera-related concerns. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support investigation, maintenance planning and follow-up where required.

## Grading

A total of 7 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. These findings should be considered with the image-quality result when reviewing the month’s overall performance. Any recurring issues affecting capture quality or grading timeliness should be documented through the appropriate operational channels, with local staff continuing to follow established procedures for escalation and review.
